steps.title: How it works
steps.1.title: Choose a place
steps.1.text: Search for your area, share your location, or drop a pin on the map.
steps.2.title: Compare nearby plants
steps.2.text: Browse one plant at a time with the arrows. Each card says exactly what is recorded — and what isn't.
steps.3.title: Go, or tell us
steps.3.text: Get directions where a plant's exact site is known, or report a problem so staff can check it.
honesty.title: What the data can — and can't — tell you
honesty.loc.title: Locations are approximate.
honesty.loc.text: The spreadsheet lists each plant's area, not its exact site, so most results point to an area centre.
honesty.status.title: Status is listed, not verified.
honesty.status.text: Every plant is marked “Fully Functional” in the source, with no date. Staff verification is shown separately when it exists.
honesty.cap.title: Capacity isn't an allowance.
honesty.cap.text: Gallons per hour is the plant's production rate — not how much one person can collect.
honesty.quality.title: Ratings aren't safety tests.
honesty.quality.text: Water-test evidence and community ratings are kept apart. No test on record means “Unknown”.
